name: Rocky Creek Farms
tagline: At the Farm — Gallatin Valley Botanical
description: In Bozeman, MT, Rocky Creek Farms raises Raspberries, Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
